target: P(NWS CLI daily precipitation > 0.00 in) at the contract CLI site over the local-standard-time climate day; trace = NO
inputs: NWS National Blend of Models (NBM, NBS text) 6-h PoP
use_rule: Used when an NBM run published by the cutoff (runtime + 5 h) is <= 24 h old and covers the window; otherwise the engine falls back to precip-v1 (GFS MOS only).

training.note: IEM NBM archive has month-long gaps (e.g. 2024-01, 2025-01, 2026-06); only days with both guidance sets are used
